figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 1. Biosynthesis of anthraquinones in fungi, bacteria, and plants by (a) Type I, (b) Type II and (c) Type III PKS (polyketide synthase), respectively. PKSs con­
denses starter acyl CoAs (typically acety-CoA) with seven malonyl-CoAs to form an ACP bound linear polyketide chain. (d) The polyketide chain undergoes two 
different modes of folding, S-Mode (in bacteria) and F-Mode (in fungi and plants). SAT- starter unit ACP transacylase; AT- acyltransferase; KS-ketosynthase; CLF- 
chain length factor; PT- product template; ACP- acyl carrier protein and TE/CLC- thioesterase/cyclase and Enz- acyl carrier protein or CoA. (e) Genes occurring in the 
bacterial (actinorhodin) and fungal (endocrocin)biosynthetic gene clusters coding for some anthraquinones (adopted form antiSMASH database).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 2. Schematic representation of anthraquinones synthesis in bacteria. (a) Biosynthesis of R1128, MAT- malonyl-CoA:ACP transacylase; KSIII- ketosynthase III, 
KR- ketoreductase; DH -dehydratase; ER - enoyl reductase; ACP- acyl carrier protein. (b) Biosynthesis of aloesaponarin II and AQ-256, KS- ketosynthase; CLF-chain 
length factor; KR-ketoreductase; ARO – aromatase and CYC - cyclase. MAT- malonyl-CoA:ACP transacylase; ACP- acyl carrier protein; KS- ketosynthase; CLF-chain 
length factor; KR-ketoreductase; ARO - aromatase; CYC - cyclase. Minimal PKS condenses eight malonyl- ACP (incase of aloesaponarin II and AQ-256) molecules to 
form a polyketide backbone, in case of R1128, minimal PKS condenses an acyl molecule derived from initiation module and seven malonyl- ACP molecules.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 3. (a) Schematic representation of biosynthesis of polyketides in fungi. PksA; PKS involved in norsolorinic acid anthrone in A. parasiticus, AptA; PKS involved in 
asperthecin biosynthesis in A. nidulans, PKS4; PKS involved in bikaverin synthesis in G. fujikuroi and ACAS; PKS involved in atrochrysone biosynthesis A. terreus. SAT- 
starter unit ACP transacylase; AT- acyltransferase; KS-ketosynthase; PT- product template; ACP- acyl carrier protein; TE/CLC- thioesterase/cyclase and TE- metallo- 
lactamase-type thioesterase (MβL-TE). (b) Intermediates and products produced by replacement of PT-ACP domian of Pks4 with PT-ACP domain of AptA and and and 
replacement of PT-ACP domains of Pks4 and PksA with PT-ACP domains of ACAS and MβL-TE (ACTE).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 4. Schematic representation of biosynthesis of endocrocin. EncA/TpcC- NR-PKS (SAT- starter unit ACP transacylase; AT- acyltransferase; KS-ketosynthase; PT- 
product template; ACP- acyl carrier protein); EncB/TpcB- metallo-lactamase-type thioesterase (MβL-TE); EncC/TpcL- anthrone oxygenase and TpcK-decarboxylase.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 5. Schematic representation of biosynthesis of emodin in geodin pathway. ACAS/GedC- NR-PKS (SAT- starter unit ACP transacylase; AT- acyltransferase; KS- 
ketosynthase; PT- product template; ACP- acyl carrier protein); ACTE/GedB- metallo-lactamase-type thioesterase (MβL-TE); GedH- anthrone oxygenase; GedI- 
decarboxylase; GedG-methyltransferase;GedF-reductase and GedK-dioxygenase.

figure_candidates.caption:

figure_candidates.label: Figure 11
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 11. (a) Hypericin mediated PDT induces celldeath after being actived at at 585 nm. Activated hypericin generated ROS that activates mitochondrial (intrinsic) 
pathway of apoptosis. (b) Proposed pathways of sennoside A activity. In large intestine, sennoside A is converted into rhein anthrone which induces its laxative effect.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 12
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 12. Hetrologous production of anthraquinone compounds. 
(a) Hetrologous production of endocrocin and emodin. SlACAS- NR-PKS from Stemphylium lycopersici; HyTe- MβL-TE from Hypoxylon sp. EC38 and AfDC- decar­
boxylase form Aspergillus fischeri. (b) Hetrologous production of DMAC; AaOKS- type III PKS from Aloe arborescens; actIII-ketoreductase; actVII- Aromatase/cyclase; 
actIV-cyclase from actinorhodin (act cluster) of Streptomyces coelicolor A3(2). (c) Hetrologous production of hypericin; RugH- P450 monooxygenase.
